hook_text: You use energy even when you are fast asleep. So where does all that energy come from?
clip_script: Sports day in Bloemfontein! Thandeka sprints, jumps, carries water, cheers. By lunch? Exhausted. Her energy is running low. In goes a plate of pap and stew and a banana. An hour later? She flies round the relay track! Food is fuel. Pap, bread, rice and potatoes are energy foods. And you use energy even when you are asleep, just to breathe and keep your heart beating. Cattle eat grass, cheetahs eat meat. Every living thing needs fuel.
visual_style: Whiteboard learner on a sports day, with an energy bar that drains as she runs and fills up again when she eats a plate of pap and a banana.
mood: Lively and sporty, like a school athletics day.
pacing: A quick tour of everything that uses energy, then food as the refill, then animals doing the same.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and list five things you used energy for today.
